description: .NET debugger, decompiler and assembly editor (the maintained dnSpy fork): decompiles to C# or VB, debugs .NET and Unity (Mono) games without source, edits IL and metadata; GUI and command-line decompiler.
notes: Commands: dnSpy (the GUI) and dnSpy.Console (decompiles from the command line; run it without arguments for every option).
Shortcuts in Scoop Apps: 'dnSpy', and 'dnSpy Console', which shows how to use dnSpy.Console and waits for a key.
Settings live in %APPDATA%\dnSpy (dnSpy.xml), outside the Scoop folder: they survive updates, and 'scoop uninstall' leaves them.
Debugging Unity (Mono) games needs a patched mono DLL in the game's folder, from https://github.com/dnSpyEx/dnSpy-Unity-mono
IL2CPP games (GameAssembly.dll, no Managed folder) have no .NET code for dnSpy to open.
Only one of dnSpyEx and extras/dnspy (the abandoned original, 6.1.8) can be installed: both add the dnSpy.Console command.
pre_install: # extras/dnspy (the original dnSpy) adds the same commands, dnSpy.Console among them: only one of the two may be installed.

if ($cmd -eq 'install' -and (installed 'dnspy')) { error "$app conflicts with dnspy (the original dnSpy, from the extras bucket), which is installed. Run 'scoop uninstall dnspy' first; your settings in %APPDATA%\dnSpy stay and dnSpyEx reads them. Scoop has already unpacked $app and treats this install as failed: the next 'scoop install' cleans it up, or run 'scoop uninstall $app'."; break }

script: # dnSpy.Console.exe prints its usage and exits at once, so the 'dnSpy Console' shortcut opens this micro-launcher instead.
':: dnSpy Console: shows what dnSpy.Console does and how to run it, then waits for a key.',
':: Written by the dnSpyEx package of the gesu Scoop bucket.',
'ECHO dnSpy.Console is the command-line decompiler of dnSpyEx: it decompiles .NET assemblies',
'ECHO to C# or Visual Basic source and project files. Run it from any console as dnSpy.Console.',
'ECHO       Decompiles all .NET files in that folder and saves them to C:\out\path',
'ECHO       Decompiles the code of a Unity (Mono) game into a project',
'ECHO       Prints the member with metadata token 0x06000123',
'ECHO Run dnSpy.Console without arguments to list every option and decompiler language.',
